subject: Intro + Dedicated Capacity Demo — Acme Health (throughput/latency)

From: Sam Patel <sam@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Priya Menon <priya@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Dedicated for Acme — throughput/latency questions

Hi Marissa,

We signed up for Redwood's hosted API last month and have been running some early experiments. We're interested in moving to Dedicated capacity for a production inference path (HIPAA-covered PII redaction + clinical summarization). Before we schedule a technical demo, can you confirm whether Redwood can meet the following targets?

- 99th percentile latency under 300ms for 1k concurrent requests (avg token lengths ~120)
- Sustained throughput of ~12k tokens/sec across a 4-GPU pool
- Support for KV-cache and prefix caching for session reuse

Also attaching a short spreadsheet with our projected Q4 volume and network requirements. Would like to get an engineering run-through and procurement next steps.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel
Director, AI Engineering — Acme Health

Short answer: yes, Dedicated is designed for those sorts of SLOs, but specifics depend on model choice, quantization, and exact request patterns.

Proposed next steps:
- 30-min demo with our SE to validate throughput/latency assumptions and review topology (KV cache, batch sizes, autoscale).
- Share any heavy prompt templates or sample payloads ahead of time so we can simulate load.

I have these times available this week: Tue 10/06 10:00–10:30 PT, Wed 10/07 14:00–14:30 PT, Thu 10/08 09:00–09:30 PT. If none work, send a couple of slots that do.

- Network: the attached sheet has egress limitations and an outline of on-prem proxies.

Also, our procurement lead (Priya) would like a short summary of required contract terms (data residency, retention, audit logs). Vivek — can you share the Dedicated checklist?
